name: Tachibana Kaoru
source:
Born into a family of Kabuki actors that has been around since the Edo period. He's a playboy who doesn't refuse to come and doesn't chase after him, and although there are constant rumors about women, he  thinks he's a fertilizer and he's never been serious.

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/nemurihime/chara/kaoru_tachibana.html]official website[/url]]
